verdict.rationale: The cloud authentication guide says a profile persists cookies, local storage and login state across browsers, so you log in once, save the profile and start future browsers already logged in. The 2FA guide names a saved profile as one of the most reliable ways past login walls. Community hands-on reports confirm the local library can reuse a real, already-logged-in Chrome profile, though one user flags that this setup exposes an unauthenticated remote-debugging port. Missing for 10: documented profile lifecycle/API details (create, update, sharing, expiry), and independent hands-on corroboration of the cloud saved-profile feature specifically rather than the local real-profile workaround.
